title: Third-person camera orbit
summary: Orbit your character with middle mouse or mobile swipes, and toggle the camera on phones.
notes: Hold middle mouse in F3 mode to orbit without turning your character; rebind it in Settings > Controls.
Tap CAM on phones to switch camera modes and swipe the right side to orbit in third person.
Keep orbit holds working across input-device switches and clear them when menus or VR interrupt play.
